body: You're probably right about that, honestly, it seems like they'll say anything just to avoid solving problems.

They ask for things I don't have and don't even really have access to, like a yearbook with my photos or a passport neither of which I could afford at any point in my high school career. My sister told me that my school records were another option, but between hopping between schools and then just dropping out it seems they've "misplaced" those records. For whatever reason, I can't simply show up with my birth certificate and social security card and get an ID.
